name: tensioner-pawl
title: Tensioner: the pawl
description: A leaf pawl whose square tip meets the ratchet's teeth: it bends over each tooth as the spool winds in and holds it from unwinding. Its root block presses down over two push pins on the frame's post.

length.rule: From its post just outside the spool gear (33 mm tips) to the ratchet: lifts a tooth (1.5 mm) at 0.7% strain

thick.rule: Nine lines: 35 mm long and 4 mm wide, it buckles at about 97 N free-ended against 50 N held at the rim for a 100 N strap (1.9×)

root.rule: The root block: long enough for its two push pins

clear.rule: Half a line round a push pin, so it goes through

snap_near.rule: The first pin, in from the root's face

snap_far.rule: The second, near the root's far end
